paper_id: PACE_ Improving Prompt with Actor-Critic Editing for Large Language Model__oa_W4402669970
title: PACE: Improving Prompt with Actor-Critic Editing for Large Language Model
motivation: 人工提示词质量差异大且改进需大量人力，现有自动提示工程只关注生成阶段而忽视编辑阶段
problem_framing: 将提示优化建模为最大化期望分数的优化问题，利用LLM近似搜索最优提示
key_insight: 将提示视为策略，借鉴强化学习actor-critic范式让LLM同时扮演执行者和评价者
method_signature: LLM双角色actor-critic迭代优化提示，多个actor-critic对提供多样化反馈
evaluation_criteria: 在24个指令归纳任务和21个BigBench任务上对比原始提示+APE+其他方法的性能提升
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: 对高度复杂问题效果有限，需人机协作释放更大潜力；某些任务如operators几乎无法改善
evidence_for_taste: The effect and human effort of the second stage far surpass
Prompt p in this context is conceptualized as a policy
the critic possesses a slightly higher significance
humans can often produce a satisfactory first attempt without much effort
The real challenge is refining and optimizing these drafts
This stabilization indicates a saturation point
thinking_moves: 识别提示工程有生成和编辑两个阶段，后者人力消耗更大但被忽视
将NLP中的提示优化问题与强化学习中的策略优化建立类比
利用LLM自身能力同时充当执行者和评价者形成反馈闭环
通过多actor多critic降低单一采样偏差影响
cites_own_work: Self-collaboration code generation via chatgpt (Dong et al., 2023a)
CODEP: grammatical seq2seq model for general-purpose code generation (Dong et al., 2023b)
